component.name: wifi-hal
component.description: Phoenix-RTOS implementation of the Infineon HAL and RTOS abstraction APIs used by WHD (LWIP_WIFI_BUILD=yes only)

properties.name: scope
properties.value: Third-party code vendored by this component only. Meant to be merged into a product-level SBOM, not scanned on its own.

properties.name: note
properties.value: Only API headers are third-party; every .c file in wi-fi/hal is Phoenix-written. Listed for licensing and completeness.

properties.name: note
properties.value: Heavily adapted; closest public releases are 1.5.0 (cyabs_rtos.h) and 1.11.0 (cyabs_rtos_impl.h).

properties.name: source
properties.value: cyhal.h, cyhal_drivers.h, cyhal_gpio.h, cyhal_hw_types.h (from cyhal_hw_types_template.h), cyhal_modules.h, cyhal_sdio.h, cyhal_spi.h

properties.name: note
properties.value: Trimmed to what WHD uses; closest public releases are 1.0.0-1.3.0.

properties.name: note
properties.value: Modified; closest public releases are 1.0.0 (cy_result.h) and 1.3.0 (cy_utils.h).

license.name: Cypress (an Infineon company) End User License Agreement
